policies.title: Mongolian ordinary passports: Grenada advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Grenada's actively linked April 2024 Embassy schedule places Mongolia in its Prior to Arrival cohort, requiring a visa before travel.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Mongolian passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
Grenada's schedule defines Prior to Arrival as a visa obtained at a Grenadian mission or consulate before travel.
The actively linked schedule was updated April 2024 and should be rechecked if Grenada publishes a replacement.
Work, study, residence, transit, crew, diplomatic, official, service and special-document routes are outside this classification.

policies.title: Mongolian ordinary passports: Panama visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy visitor schedule names Mongolia in its no-visa-required cohort for stays of up to three months.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Mongolian passport holder travelling as a short visitor for up to three months.
Passport validity, funds, onward travel and final admission remain governed by Panama's authorities.
Work, residence, transit, diplomatic, official and special-document routes remain outside scope.
